pr_title: Add cluster and node name to driver
pr_body:
This adds cluster and node name to each driver in the query profiling output:
```
    "drivers": [
      {
        "task_description": "data",
        "cluster_name": "runTask", <----------
        "node_name": "runTask-0", <----------
        "start_millis": 1740562206428,
        "stop_millis": 1740562206466,
        "took_nanos": 37984254,
        "cpu_nanos": 36060202,
        "iterations": 2,
```

Depends on: #123457

Close: #113025
pr_comments: Also, a CCS test would be nice to have, though not sure if we have one for the profile bit.
I simplified the change to no longer require `NodeInfoSupplier`

issue_context.title: ESQL: `profile` should include the node name
issue_context.body:
### Description

The `profile` output for each driver should include the node that ran the driver. You can can infer this from which nodes have the shards assigned to them, but it'd be nicer to be told explicitly.

review_comments: I presume w could use TestDriverFactory here?
Don't we have the new TestDriverFactor for this?
This one uses different arguments. They are specific to this test case only, so I kept them separate.
